investigation_notes.Description: A Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on the Vitalis Lab Diagnostics page at https://www.vitalislab-diagnostics.de/leistungen. The domain vitalislab-diagnostics.de resolves to IP 104.26.10.224, a Cloudflare CDN IP with 7 years of domain age and NameCheap as registrar. The on-page branding shown in the evidence appears as Vitalis Lab branding rather than the exact Vitalis Healthcare logo referenced by the alert, suggesting possible asset reuse or brand confusion rather than a direct impersonation. Overall, this alert is Low Priority pending further monitoring for consistency in branding and absence of credential-stealing elements.
